results.explanation: The Hydrogen Corridors Coalition builds hydrogen and ammonia export corridors linking North Africa, East Africa and European ports, which matches your focus on green hydrogen export corridors.
Dr. Samuel Mwangi has advised on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping, and is a participant in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition. You already know each other through a co-member initiative.
The East Africa Power Pool Secretariat works on green hydrogen and climate finance and takes part in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition, which builds export corridors from North and East Africa.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, advises on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping and takes part in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition. You already know each other through a board peer connection.

Skills for the Green Transition designs reskilling programmes for hydrogen and renewable energy jobs in Africa and Asia-Pacific. It is related to the hydrogen corridors work, though it does not build export corridors itself.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, advises on hydrogen export corridors and ammonia shipping and attended the Summit session on financing the hydrogen economy. She is named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition report on a Rotterdam import terminal.

Ahmed Khalil, Director of Energy Transition at Gulf Sovereign Capital, sources hydrogen and ammonia projects in MENA and advises on export corridors, so they can speak to Gulf investor interest in hydrogen.

Laila Al-Suwaidi, CEO of Gulf Sovereign Capital, works on electrolyser deployment and long-term green hydrogen offtake, and sets the fund's investment strategy. Introductions go through the Managing Director.

Omar Al-Mansoori, Managing Director of Energy Investments at Gulf Sovereign Capital, leads the fund's hydrogen and battery-mineral stakes and works on green hydrogen offtake agreements. All contact is managed by the Secretariat.
Viktor Lang, Founder & CEO of SecureGrid Labs, works on cybersecurity and grid intrusion detection. He does not cover hydrogen or Gulf investment, so he is not a fit for this brief.

Prof. Klaus Weber, Director of the European Climate Finance Institute, has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets, which fits a climate finance interview. He also attended the public ocean finance breakfast on blue bonds.

Julia Schmidt, Senior Economist at the European Climate Finance Institute, has led green bond and transition-finance programmes for emerging markets. She also works on resilient trade routes, logistics and nearshoring strategies.

Victoria Hale, Chair & CEO of Atlas Logistics, structures blended-finance vehicles that crowd private capital into transition projects. She is named in the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition Annual Report 2026 as chairing its port infrastructure group.

Dr. Samuel Mwangi, Secretary General of the East Africa Power Pool Secretariat, structures blended-finance vehicles that crowd private capital into transition projects. He is a member of the Hydrogen Corridors Coalition, which is also named in the Annual Report 2026.

Rafael Ortega Ruiz, Innovation Director at Andes AgriTech in Colombia, works on climate-resilient agriculture and credit products for smallholders. He already knows the Forum through a shared session on digital credit for small producers, which discussed combining agronomic and mobile payment data.
Andes AgriTech works on food security and financial inclusion in the Americas. It runs the Water-Food Nexus Lab, which pilots joint water and agriculture work, relevant to smallholder programmes.

Thabo Nkosi, CEO of Ubuntu Microfinance in South Africa, expands access to microfinance and digital credit. You already worked together, and he sits in the Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance on credit scoring for the unbanked.

Isabel Fernández, President of Banco Solidario de las Américas in Mexico, expands microfinance and digital credit for small producers. You already share a session on digital credit for smallholders, and she is in the Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance.

Tomás Herrera, Digital Finance Director at Banco Solidario de las Américas in Mexico, works on digital credit access for small producers. You already share a session on digital credit, and he is in the Inclusive Digital Finance Alliance on credit scoring.

Dr. Léa Fontaine dirige la recherche hydrogène au Lumière Institute et travaille sur les électrolyseurs et le coût de l'hydrogène vert en Afrique du Nord, un sujet central pour ce panel. Elle est citée dans le rapport annuel de la Hydrogen Corridors Coalition.
Dr. Marcus Feld est conseiller senior en hydrogène au Lumière Institute, spécialiste reconnu en Europe des corridors d'exportation d'hydrogène. Flag: opted out of matchmaking.

Aïssatou Diallo dirige les programmes eau chez Sahara Solar Holdings au Sénégal et travaille aussi sur le déploiement d'électrolyseurs et les contrats d'achat d'hydrogène vert. Elle a participé à une visite de terrain sur le lien eau-alimentation en 2026.

Hamza Rachidi est ingénieur en chef pour les électrolyseurs chez Sahara Solar Holdings au Maroc et conseille sur les corridors d'exportation d'hydrogène. Une autre intervenante l'a recommandé pour le panel de Genève, où il pourra parler des électrolyseurs du projet Noor Atlantic.

Ahmed Khalil dirige la transition énergétique chez Gulf Sovereign Capital aux Émirats et suit les projets d'hydrogène et d'ammoniac au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique du Nord pour son fonds. Les notes du secrétariat le mentionnent comme futur observateur du groupe de travail sur les contrats d'achat.

Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance, works on cyber resilience for critical infrastructure and on AI policy dialogues. Tamm is also in the Responsible AI Charter and the Cyber Resilience Pact.
Dr. Nadia Petrova, Head of AI Policy at CyberShield Alliance, works on AI policy and regulation. Petrova is a participant in the Responsible AI Charter on AI risk management.

Hiroshi Tanaka, Chief Scientist at Singapore Digital Trust Lab, builds practical frameworks for responsible AI and model risk oversight, and has built incident-response cooperation between public and private operators.

Arjun Mehta, CTO at FutureSkills Foundation, works on practical frameworks for responsible AI and model risk oversight, and has built incident-response cooperation between public and private operators.
Dr. Rachel Kim, CEO of Helix Health AI, works on practical frameworks for responsible AI and model risk oversight. Kim is also a participant in the Responsible AI Charter.

Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director at Mekong Water Partnership in Vietnam, works on water scarcity, irrigation efficiency and river-basin management, and takes part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab. They attended a Mekong delta field visit on the water-food nexus.

Dr. Ong Mei Ling, Director of Basin Finance at Mekong Water Partnership, works on water scarcity and river-basin management and takes part in the Water-Food Nexus Lab. Ling also attended the Mekong delta water-food nexus field visit.

Pedro Alves, Head of Agronomy at Andes AgriTech in Brazil, scales agritech that raises yields and works on water scarcity and irrigation efficiency. Alves is a Water-Food Nexus Lab participant in the Andes.
Mekong Water Partnership, based in Vietnam, works across water, food security and ocean themes in Asia-Pacific and runs the Water-Food Nexus Lab initiative.
The Water-Food Nexus Lab pilots joint water and agriculture interventions in Asia-Pacific, the Americas and Africa, covering the Mekong, the Andes and the Sahel.

The Resilient Supply Chains Dialogue is a quarterly forum on supply-chain risk for producers, shippers and trade officials across Africa and Europe, covering critical minerals, so it suits a mining company.

Project Tidewater is a forming co-investment platform for African battery-mineral processing, matching the critical-minerals focus, and it is named in an investment memo draft titled Project Tidewater Investment Memo DRAFT.

Ingrid Solberg, Ocean Programme Lead at Pacific Ocean Trust, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds, and takes part in the Blue Economy Accelerator. Solberg is a direct match for ocean conservation finance.

Ana Costa, Ocean Finance Lead at Northstar Impact Partners, works on marine conservation finance and blue bonds and also leads green bond programmes. Costa participates in the Blue Economy Accelerator.
Nguyen Thi Lan, Executive Director of Mekong Water Partnership, works on blue bonds and marine conservation finance alongside water and agriculture topics. Lan is a secondary match for ocean finance.

Kalesi Naivalu, Director at Pacific Ocean Trust, structures blended-finance vehicles for transition projects and supports coastal resilience work. Naivalu is in the Blue Economy Accelerator, which prepares blue-bond pipelines.
The Blue Economy Accelerator prepares blue-bond pipelines for Pacific and Atlantic island states. It is an initiative directly focused on ocean conservation finance.
The Responsible AI Charter is a voluntary AI risk management charter signed by 40 member organisations, with annual implementation reviews, so it matches the request on responsible AI leadership.
Mikko Tamm, Director at CyberShield Alliance in Estonia, works on AI governance and contributes to AI policy and regulation dialogues, and is linked to the Responsible AI Charter.
